The 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair closed Monday (Nov 9) at the Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 countries and cities, 1,600 booths over four days. Double 11 falls on Wednesday (Nov 11). Shopee's draw with EVA Air runs Oct 26-Nov 13: 23 return tickets over 19 days, with two Los Angeles return tickets on Nov 11 itself. Discounts, cashback and free delivery often cannot be combined — compare the final amount you actually pay, and check each coupon's threshold and quota first.

The northeast monsoon keeps northern Taiwan wet and cool into Nov 11: daytime highs of 24-27 degrees, lows below 20 at night and in the early morning. Kaohsiung stays warm at 28-30 degrees by day. Check the forecast for your destination before you pack.

Hot-spring season is here. Eat a little first, keep soaks short, and get out at once if you feel dizzy. Shower before entering the pool, keep towels out of the water, and drink water afterwards.

A2 · 雙11的話 · Double 11-woorden
Double 11 gives you four useful words: 清單 (shopping list), 實付金額 (the final amount you pay), 領券 (claiming coupons) and 鑑賞期 (the cooling-off period). Learn them once, and every sale makes sense.

Double 11 geeft je vier nuttige woorden: 清單 (boodschappenlijst), 實付金額 (het eindbedrag dat je betaalt), 領券 (coupons claimen) en 鑑賞期 (de bedenktijd). Leer ze één keer en elke uitverkoop wordt begrijpelijk.
Four Double 11 words: 清單, 實付金額, 領券, 鑑賞期.

清單 is the list you write before you shop. 實付金額 is what you actually pay after discounts. 領券 means claiming a coupon before it runs out. 鑑賞期 is the 7 days after delivery when you can return most goods.

The 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair closed Monday (Nov 9) at the Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 countries and cities, 1,600 booths over four days. In its 40th year and 34th edition, the fair took the new name ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Some airlines' online fairs run into mid-to-late November — check dates and terms before you buy.

Die ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair 2026 endete am Montag (9. Nov.) im Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 Länder und Städte, 1.600 Stände an vier Tagen. Im 40. Jahr und in der 34. Ausgabe erhielt die Messe den neuen Namen ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Einige Online-Messen der Fluggesellschaften laufen bis Mitte/Ende November — prüfe vor dem Kauf Daten und Bedingungen.

Double 11 falls on Wednesday (Nov 11). Shopee's draw with EVA Air runs Oct 26-Nov 13: 23 return tickets over 19 days, with two Los Angeles return tickets on Nov 11 itself. Discounts, cashback and free delivery often cannot be combined — compare the final amount you actually pay, and check each coupon's threshold and quota first.

Double 11 fällt auf Mittwoch (11. Nov.). Shopees Verlosung mit EVA Air läuft vom 26. Okt. bis 13. Nov.: 23 Hin- und Rückflugtickets an 19 Tagen, davon zwei Los-Angeles-Tickets am 11. Nov. selbst. Rabatte, Cashback und Gratisversand lassen sich oft nicht kombinieren — vergleiche den Endbetrag, den du wirklich zahlst, und prüfe zuerst Schwelle und Kontingent jedes Gutscheins.

The northeast monsoon keeps northern Taiwan wet and cool into Nov 11: daytime highs of 24-27 degrees, lows below 20 at night and in the early morning. Kaohsiung stays warm at 28-30 degrees by day. Check the forecast for your destination before you pack.

Der Nordostmonsun hält Nordtaiwan bis zum 11. Nov. nass und kühl: tagsüber 24–27 Grad, nachts und frühmorgens unter 20 Grad. Kaohsiung bleibt tagsüber warm bei 28–30 Grad. Prüfe vor dem Packen die Vorhersage für dein Ziel.
Hot-spring season is here. Eat a little first, keep soaks short, and get out at once if you feel dizzy. Shower before entering the pool, keep towels out of the water, and drink water afterwards.
Die Thermalbad-Saison ist da. Iss vorher etwas, bade nur kurz und steige sofort aus, wenn dir schwindlig wird. Dusche vor dem Becken, halte Handtücher aus dem Wasser und trinke danach Wasser.

The 2026 Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival runs Nov 6-22, screening the nominated films: 587 entries, nominations announced Oct 1, with one film leading at 11 nominations. The 63rd Golden Horse Awards follow on Sunday, Nov 22 at the Taipei Music Center — red carpet 17:00, ceremony 18:30, hosted by Will Or (Ko Wai-lam).

Das Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival 2026 läuft vom 6. bis 22. Nov. und zeigt die nominierten Filme: 587 Einreichungen, Nominierungen am 1. Okt. bekannt gegeben, ein Film führt mit 11 Nominierungen. Die 63. Golden Horse Awards folgen am Sonntag, 22. Nov., im Taipei Music Center — roter Teppich 17:00 Uhr, Zeremonie 18:30 Uhr, moderiert von Will Or (Ko Wai-lam).

Kaohsiung's International Steel Sculpture Festival (Oct 23-Nov 22, SUPER STAGE) enters its final two weeks, with weekend programmes Nov 14-15 at the Penglai B3 warehouse and in Yancheng. The SUPER SAFE theme show turns the warehouse into a steel safe holding Kaohsiung's labour memories — including 85-year-old Lin Hung Yu-hsiu's everlasting metal flowers.

Kaohsiungs International Steel Sculpture Festival (23. Okt.–22. Nov., SUPER STAGE) geht in die letzten zwei Wochen, mit Wochenendprogrammen am 14.–15. Nov. im Penglai-B3-Lagerhaus und in Yancheng. Die SUPER-SAFE-Themenschau verwandelt das Lagerhaus in einen Stahlsafe mit Kaohsiungs Arbeitserinnerungen — darunter die unvergänglichen Metallblumen der 85-jährigen Lin Hung Yu-hsiu.
Next Sunday (Nov 22) is also Xiaoxue (Minor Snow), the solar term after Lidong: deeper winter, time to dress warmly.
Nächsten Sonntag (22. Nov.) ist auch Xiaoxue (Kleiner Schnee), der Sonnenabschnitt nach Lidong: tieferer Winter, Zeit sich warm anzuziehen.

The Wei Chuan Dragons' championship parade is set for next Sunday (Nov 22) at 14:00, from Tianmu Baseball Stadium to the Taipei Dome. A two-day fans' thanksgiving festival runs Nov 21-22 at Tianmu: a grass concert and overnight camping on the 21st, player activities on the 22nd. Taipei City doubles U-Sport points all November: 10 points per visit instead of 5, at 267 venues.

Die Meisterparade der Wei Chuan Dragons ist für nächsten Sonntag (22. Nov.) um 14:00 Uhr angesetzt, vom Tianmu Baseball Stadium zum Taipei Dome. Ein zweitägiges Dankesfest für Fans läuft am 21.–22. Nov. in Tianmu: Rasenkonzert und Übernachtungscamping am 21., Spieleraktivitäten am 22. Die Stadt Taipeh verdoppelt im ganzen November die U-Sport-Punkte: 10 Punkte pro Besuch statt 5, an 267 Orten.
Four words: 遊行 (parade), 感謝祭 (fans' thanksgiving festival), 集點 (collecting points), 封王 (clinching the title).

Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026 runs Sat-Sun Nov 14-15 at Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, 10:00-17:00, free entry. Theme: a century of fairy tales, with 17 interactive art stalls, 900+ student installations and 4-metre puppets. The night parade starts 20:30 on Nov 14 from Lee Gardens.

Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026 läuft Sa–So, 14.–15. Nov., im Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, 10:00–17:00 Uhr, Eintritt frei. Thema: ein Jahrhundert Märchen, mit 17 interaktiven Kunstständen, über 900 Schülerarbeiten und 4 Meter hohen Puppen. Die Nachtparade startet am 14. Nov. um 20:30 Uhr an den Lee Gardens.

Hong Kong's November is busy: Janice Vidal's 20th-anniversary concerts at the Hong Kong Coliseum on Nov 14, 15 and 17; the comic-based restaurant theatre The Celestial Bookhouse in Wan Chai on Nov 14-15; and a Pokémon 30th-anniversary display at Festival Walk from Nov 11.

Hongkongs November ist voll: Janice Vidals Konzerte zum 20. Jubiläum im Hong Kong Coliseum am 14., 15. und 17. Nov.; das comicbasierte Restauranttheater The Celestial Bookhouse in Wan Chai am 14.–15. Nov.; und eine Pokémon-Ausstellung zum 30. Jubiläum in der Festival Walk ab 11. Nov.

Big discounts do not always mean cheap. The 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair closed Monday (Nov 9) at the Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 countries and cities, 1,600 booths over four days. In its 40th year and 34th edition, the fair took the new name ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Some airlines' online fairs run into mid-to-late November — check dates and terms before you buy.

La foire internationale du voyage ITF Taiwan 2026 s'est terminée lundi (9 nov.) au Nangang Exhibition Center : 123 pays et villes, 1 600 stands sur quatre jours. Pour sa 40e année et sa 34e édition, la foire a pris le nouveau nom d'ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Certaines foires en ligne des compagnies aériennes se prolongent jusqu'à mi-fin novembre — vérifiez dates et conditions avant d'acheter.

Double 11 falls on Wednesday (Nov 11). Shopee's draw with EVA Air runs Oct 26-Nov 13: 23 return tickets over 19 days, with two Los Angeles return tickets on Nov 11 itself. Discounts, cashback and free delivery often cannot be combined — compare the final amount you actually pay, and check each coupon's threshold and quota first.

Réductions, cashback et livraison gratuite ne se combinent souvent pas — comparez le montant final que vous payez vraiment, et vérifiez d'abord le seuil et le quota de chaque coupon.

The northeast monsoon keeps northern Taiwan wet and cool into Nov 11: daytime highs of 24-27 degrees, lows below 20 at night and in the early morning. Kaohsiung stays warm at 28-30 degrees by day. Check the forecast for your destination before you pack.

La mousson du nord-est garde le nord de Taïwan humide et frais jusqu'au 11 nov. : 24-27 degrés le jour, moins de 20 degrés la nuit et tôt le matin. Kaohsiung reste chaude, 28-30 degrés le jour. Vérifiez la météo de votre destination avant de faire vos bagages.
Hot-spring season is here. Eat a little first, keep soaks short, and get out at once if you feel dizzy. Shower before entering the pool, keep towels out of the water, and drink water afterwards.

La saison des sources chaudes est là. Mangez un peu d'abord, restez peu de temps dans l'eau, et sortez aussitôt si vous avez le vertige. Douchez-vous avant d'entrer dans le bassin, gardez les serviettes hors de l'eau, et buvez de l'eau après.

Kaohsiung's International Steel Sculpture Festival (Oct 23-Nov 22, SUPER STAGE) enters its final two weeks, with weekend programmes Nov 14-15 at the Penglai B3 warehouse and in Yancheng. The SUPER SAFE theme show turns the warehouse into a steel safe holding Kaohsiung's labour memories — including 85-year-old Lin Hung Yu-hsiu's everlasting metal flowers.

Le Festival international de sculpture d'acier de Kaohsiung (23 oct.-22 nov., SUPER STAGE) entre dans ses deux dernières semaines, avec des programmes le week-end des 14-15 nov. à l'entrepôt B3 de Penglai et à Yancheng. L'exposition SUPER SAFE transforme l'entrepôt en un coffre-fort d'acier gardant les souvenirs de travail de Kaohsiung — dont les fleurs de métal éternelles de Lin Hung Yu-hsiu, 85 ans.
Next Sunday (Nov 22) is also Xiaoxue (Minor Snow), the solar term after Lidong: deeper winter, time to dress warmly.

The Wei Chuan Dragons' championship parade is set for next Sunday (Nov 22) at 14:00, from Tianmu Baseball Stadium to the Taipei Dome. Hong Kong's November is busy: Janice Vidal's 20th-anniversary concerts at the Hong Kong Coliseum on Nov 14, 15 and 17; the comic-based restaurant theatre The Celestial Bookhouse in Wan Chai on Nov 14-15; and a Pokémon 30th-anniversary display at Festival Walk from Nov 11.

Big discounts do not always mean cheap. Check three things: the spending threshold, the quota (many coupons are limited and first-come-first-served), and whether the reward is an instant discount or later points. Cashback is not a discount — the final amount you pay is what counts. Cross-border parcels under NT$2,000 are duty-free; over that, duty applies.

Les grosses réductions ne veulent pas toujours dire bon marché. Vérifiez trois choses : le seuil de dépense, le quota (beaucoup de coupons sont limités, premiers arrivés premiers servis), et si la récompense est une réduction immédiate ou des points plus tard. Le cashback n'est pas une réduction — c'est le montant final payé qui compte. Les colis transfrontaliers de moins de 2 000 NT$ sont exempts de droits ; au-delà, des droits s'appliquent.

The 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair closed Monday (Nov 9) at the Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 countries and cities, 1,600 booths over four days. In its 40th year and 34th edition, the fair took the new name ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Some airlines' online fairs run into mid-to-late November — check dates and terms before you buy.

La Fiera Internazionale del Viaggio ITF Taiwan 2026 si è chiusa lunedì (9 nov.) al Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 paesi e città, 1.600 stand in quattro giorni. Al 40º anno e alla 34ª edizione, la fiera ha preso il nuovo nome ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Alcune fiere online delle compagnie aeree continuano fino a metà-fine novembre: controlla date e condizioni prima di comprare.

Double 11 falls on Wednesday (Nov 11). Shopee's draw with EVA Air runs Oct 26-Nov 13: 23 return tickets over 19 days, with two Los Angeles return tickets on Nov 11 itself. Discounts, cashback and free delivery often cannot be combined — compare the final amount you actually pay, and check each coupon's threshold and quota first.

Sconti, cashback e spedizione gratuita spesso non si possono combinare: confronta l'importo finale che paghi davvero e controlla prima soglia e quota di ogni coupon.

The northeast monsoon keeps northern Taiwan wet and cool into Nov 11: daytime highs of 24-27 degrees, lows below 20 at night and in the early morning. Kaohsiung stays warm at 28-30 degrees by day. Check the forecast for your destination before you pack.

Il monsone di nord-est mantiene il nord di Taiwan umido e fresco fino all'11 nov.: massime di 24-27 gradi di giorno, minime sotto i 20 di notte e al mattino presto. Kaohsiung resta calda, 28-30 gradi di giorno. Controlla le previsioni della destinazione prima di fare la valigia.
Hot-spring season is here. Eat a little first, keep soaks short, and get out at once if you feel dizzy. Shower before entering the pool, keep towels out of the water, and drink water afterwards.

È arrivata la stagione delle terme. Mangia un po' prima, fai bagni brevi ed esci subito se ti gira la testa. Fai la doccia prima di entrare in piscina, tieni gli asciugamani fuori dall'acqua e bevi acqua dopo.

The 2026 Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival runs Nov 6-22, screening the nominated films: 587 entries, nominations announced Oct 1, with one film leading at 11 nominations. The 63rd Golden Horse Awards follow on Sunday, Nov 22 at the Taipei Music Center — red carpet 17:00, ceremony 18:30, hosted by Will Or (Ko Wai-lam).

Il Festival del Cinema Golden Horse di Taipei 2026 dura dal 6 al 22 nov. e proietta i film nominati: 587 candidature, nomination annunciate il 1º ott., un film in testa con 11 nomination. La 63ª cerimonia dei Golden Horse Awards segue domenica 22 nov. al Taipei Music Center: tappeto rosso alle 17:00, cerimonia alle 18:30, presentata da Will Or (Ko Wai-lam).

Kaohsiung's International Steel Sculpture Festival (Oct 23-Nov 22, SUPER STAGE) enters its final two weeks, with weekend programmes Nov 14-15 at the Penglai B3 warehouse and in Yancheng. The SUPER SAFE theme show turns the warehouse into a steel safe holding Kaohsiung's labour memories — including 85-year-old Lin Hung Yu-hsiu's everlasting metal flowers.

Il Festival Internazionale di Scultura d'Acciaio di Kaohsiung (23 ott.-22 nov., SUPER STAGE) entra nelle ultime due settimane, con programmi nel fine settimana del 14-15 nov. al magazzino B3 di Penglai e a Yancheng. La mostra SUPER SAFE trasforma il magazzino in una cassaforte d'acciaio che custodisce i ricordi del lavoro di Kaohsiung, tra cui i fiori di metallo eterni di Lin Hung Yu-hsiu, 85 anni.
Next Sunday (Nov 22) is also Xiaoxue (Minor Snow), the solar term after Lidong: deeper winter, time to dress warmly.
Domenica prossima (22 nov.) è anche Xiaoxue (Neve Minore), il termine solare dopo Lidong: inverno più profondo, momento di vestirsi pesanti.

The Wei Chuan Dragons' championship parade is set for next Sunday (Nov 22) at 14:00, from Tianmu Baseball Stadium to the Taipei Dome. A two-day fans' thanksgiving festival runs Nov 21-22 at Tianmu: a grass concert and overnight camping on the 21st, player activities on the 22nd. Taipei City doubles U-Sport points all November: 10 points per visit instead of 5, at 267 venues.

La parata del titolo dei Wei Chuan Dragons è fissata per domenica prossima (22 nov.) alle 14:00, dallo stadio di baseball di Tianmu al Taipei Dome. Un festival di ringraziamento di due giorni per i tifosi dura il 21-22 nov. a Tianmu: concerto sul prato e campeggio notturno il 21, attività con i giocatori il 22. La città di Taipei raddoppia i punti U-Sport per tutto novembre: 10 punti a visita invece di 5, in 267 sedi.
Four words: 遊行 (parade), 感謝祭 (fans' thanksgiving festival), 集點 (collecting points), 封王 (clinching the title).
Quattro parole: 遊行 (parata), 感謝祭 (festival di ringraziamento per i tifosi), 集點 (raccogliere punti), 封王 (conquistare il titolo).

Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026 runs Sat-Sun Nov 14-15 at Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, 10:00-17:00, free entry. Theme: a century of fairy tales, with 17 interactive art stalls, 900+ student installations and 4-metre puppets. The night parade starts 20:30 on Nov 14 from Lee Gardens.

Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026 dura sab.-dom. 14-15 nov. al Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, dalle 10:00 alle 17:00, ingresso gratuito. Tema: un secolo di fiabe, con 17 stand d'arte interattivi, oltre 900 installazioni di studenti e marionette di 4 metri. La parata notturna parte alle 20:30 il 14 nov. da Lee Gardens.

Hong Kong's November is busy: Janice Vidal's 20th-anniversary concerts at the Hong Kong Coliseum on Nov 14, 15 and 17; the comic-based restaurant theatre The Celestial Bookhouse in Wan Chai on Nov 14-15; and a Pokémon 30th-anniversary display at Festival Walk from Nov 11.

Check three things: the spending threshold, the quota (many coupons are limited and first-come-first-served), and whether the reward is an instant discount or later points. Cashback is not a discount — the final amount you pay is what counts. Cross-border parcels under NT$2,000 are duty-free; over that, duty applies.

Controlla tre cose: la soglia di spesa, la quota (molti coupon sono limitati e valgono in ordine di arrivo) e se il premio è uno sconto immediato o punti successivi. Il cashback non è uno sconto: conta l'importo finale che paghi. I pacchi transfrontalieri sotto i 2.000 NT$ sono esenti da dazi; oltre, si applicano dazi.

The 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair closed Monday (Nov 9) at the Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 countries and cities, 1,600 booths over four days. In its 40th year and 34th edition, the fair took the new name ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Some airlines' online fairs run into mid-to-late November — check dates and terms before you buy.

La Feria Internacional de Viajes ITF Taiwán 2026 cerró el lunes (9 nov.) en el Nangang Exhibition Center: 123 países y ciudades, 1.600 casetas en cuatro días. En su 40.º año y 34.ª edición, la feria tomó el nuevo nombre de ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair. Algunas ferias en línea de las aerolíneas siguen hasta mediados o fines de noviembre; comprueba fechas y condiciones antes de comprar.

Double 11 falls on Wednesday (Nov 11). Shopee's draw with EVA Air runs Oct 26-Nov 13: 23 return tickets over 19 days, with two Los Angeles return tickets on Nov 11 itself. Discounts, cashback and free delivery often cannot be combined — compare the final amount you actually pay, and check each coupon's threshold and quota first.

El Double 11 cae en miércoles (11 nov.). El sorteo de Shopee con EVA Air dura del 26 oct. al 13 nov.: 23 billetes de ida y vuelta en 19 días, con dos billetes a Los Ángeles el mismo 11 nov. Descuentos, cashback y envío gratis a menudo no se pueden combinar: compara la cantidad final que pagas de verdad y comprueba primero el umbral y el cupo de cada cupón.

The northeast monsoon keeps northern Taiwan wet and cool into Nov 11: daytime highs of 24-27 degrees, lows below 20 at night and in the early morning. Kaohsiung stays warm at 28-30 degrees by day. Check the forecast for your destination before you pack.

El monzón del noreste mantiene el norte de Taiwán húmedo y fresco hasta el 11 nov.: máximas de 24-27 grados de día, mínimas por debajo de 20 de noche y a primera hora. Kaohsiung sigue cálida, con 28-30 grados de día. Consulta el pronóstico de tu destino antes de hacer la maleta.
Hot-spring season is here. Eat a little first, keep soaks short, and get out at once if you feel dizzy. Shower before entering the pool, keep towels out of the water, and drink water afterwards.

Llegó la temporada de aguas termales. Come un poco primero, date baños cortos y sal enseguida si te mareas. Dúchate antes de entrar en la piscina, mantén las toallas fuera del agua y bebe agua después.

The 2026 Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival runs Nov 6-22, screening the nominated films: 587 entries, nominations announced Oct 1, with one film leading at 11 nominations. The 63rd Golden Horse Awards follow on Sunday, Nov 22 at the Taipei Music Center — red carpet 17:00, ceremony 18:30, hosted by Will Or (Ko Wai-lam).

El Festival de Cine Golden Horse de Taipéi 2026 dura del 6 al 22 nov. y proyecta las películas nominadas: 587 candidaturas, nominaciones anunciadas el 1 oct., una película en cabeza con 11 nominaciones. La 63.ª ceremonia de los Golden Horse Awards sigue el domingo 22 nov. en el Taipei Music Center: alfombra roja a las 17:00, ceremonia a las 18:30, presentada por Will Or (Ko Wai-lam).

Kaohsiung's International Steel Sculpture Festival (Oct 23-Nov 22, SUPER STAGE) enters its final two weeks, with weekend programmes Nov 14-15 at the Penglai B3 warehouse and in Yancheng. The SUPER SAFE theme show turns the warehouse into a steel safe holding Kaohsiung's labour memories — including 85-year-old Lin Hung Yu-hsiu's everlasting metal flowers.

El Festival Internacional de Escultura de Acero de Kaohsiung (23 oct.-22 nov., SUPER STAGE) entra en sus dos últimas semanas, con programas de fin de semana el 14-15 nov. en el almacén B3 de Penglai y en Yancheng. La muestra SUPER SAFE convierte el almacén en una caja fuerte de acero que guarda los recuerdos obreros de Kaohsiung, incluidas las flores de metal eternas de Lin Hung Yu-hsiu, de 85 años.
Next Sunday (Nov 22) is also Xiaoxue (Minor Snow), the solar term after Lidong: deeper winter, time to dress warmly.
El próximo domingo (22 nov.) es también Xiaoxue (Nieve Menor), el término solar después de Lidong: invierno más profundo, momento de abrigarse.

The Wei Chuan Dragons' championship parade is set for next Sunday (Nov 22) at 14:00, from Tianmu Baseball Stadium to the Taipei Dome. A two-day fans' thanksgiving festival runs Nov 21-22 at Tianmu: a grass concert and overnight camping on the 21st, player activities on the 22nd. Taipei City doubles U-Sport points all November: 10 points per visit instead of 5, at 267 venues.

El desfile del título de los Wei Chuan Dragons está fijado para el próximo domingo (22 nov.) a las 14:00, del estadio de béisbol de Tianmu al Taipei Dome. Un festival de agradecimiento de dos días para los aficionados dura el 21-22 nov. en Tianmu: concierto en el césped y acampada nocturna el 21, actividades con los jugadores el 22. La ciudad de Taipéi duplica los puntos U-Sport todo noviembre: 10 puntos por visita en vez de 5, en 267 sedes.
Four words: 遊行 (parade), 感謝祭 (fans' thanksgiving festival), 集點 (collecting points), 封王 (clinching the title).
Cuatro palabras: 遊行 (desfile), 感謝祭 (festival de agradecimiento para los aficionados), 集點 (acumular puntos), 封王 (conseguir el título).

Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026 runs Sat-Sun Nov 14-15 at Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, 10:00-17:00, free entry. Theme: a century of fairy tales, with 17 interactive art stalls, 900+ student installations and 4-metre puppets. The night parade starts 20:30 on Nov 14 from Lee Gardens.

Standard Chartered Arts in the Park 2026 dura sáb.-dom. 14-15 nov. en Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, de 10:00 a 17:00, entrada gratuita. Tema: un siglo de cuentos de hadas, con 17 puestos de arte interactivos, más de 900 instalaciones de estudiantes y marionetas de 4 metros. El desfile nocturno sale a las 20:30 el 14 nov. desde Lee Gardens.

Hong Kong's November is busy: Janice Vidal's 20th-anniversary concerts at the Hong Kong Coliseum on Nov 14, 15 and 17; the comic-based restaurant theatre The Celestial Bookhouse in Wan Chai on Nov 14-15; and a Pokémon 30th-anniversary display at Festival Walk from Nov 11.

Noviembre en Hong Kong viene cargado: los conciertos del 20.º aniversario de Janice Vidal en el Hong Kong Coliseum el 14, 15 y 17 nov.; el teatro-restaurante basado en un cómic The Celestial Bookhouse en Wan Chai el 14-15 nov.; y una exposición de Pokémon por el 30.º aniversario en Festival Walk desde el 11 nov.

Big discounts do not always mean cheap. Check three things: the spending threshold, the quota (many coupons are limited and first-come-first-served), and whether the reward is an instant discount or later points. Cashback is not a discount — the final amount you pay is what counts. Cross-border parcels under NT$2,000 are duty-free; over that, duty applies.

Los grandes descuentos no siempre significan barato. Comprueba tres cosas: el umbral de gasto, el cupo (muchos cupones son limitados y van por orden de llegada) y si la recompensa es un descuento inmediato o puntos para después. El cashback no es un descuento: lo que cuenta es la cantidad final que pagas. Los paquetes transfronterizos de menos de 2.000 NT$ están exentos de impuestos; por encima, se aplican aranceles.
